{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgRAk89YxkpJU5hNdmizd","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnGet.md ===\n# FEATURE: TxnGet\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn get` command writes one stored transaction row by id. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn get |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.transactions.txn_row, cli.output.write_table, cli.registry.register |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn get <id>` reads one stored transaction and writes it as CSV. It is read-only and\nnever changes the store.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Item | Contract |\n|------|----------|\n| Command | `ledger txn get <id>`, exactly one argument |\n| Success output | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the one transaction row; amount has exactly two decimals |\n| Exit 0 | The transaction exists |\n| Exit 2 | Wrong argument count; one stderr line showing `ledger txn get <id>` |\n| Exit 3 | The id is not a positive integer (`abc`, `0`, `-1`, `1.5`, empty); it is never reported as absent |\n| Exit 4 | The id is a valid positive integer but no such transaction is stored |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Register the command in `cli.commands.txn_get` with arity 1 to 1 and the usage line above.\n2. Parse the id: digits only, value at least 1. Anything else raises Rejected (exit 3).\n3. Look the row up with `transactions.get`; none raises NotFound (exit 4).\n4. Format the row with `txn_row` and call `write_table` as the final statement.\n5. A failing command writes nothing to stdout.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-get-existing ===\nIntent: Getting a stored transaction writes the declared header and exactly its row.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTG1\"\ncat = \"ZZTGC1\"\nday = \"2026-05-01\"\namount_text = \"45.50\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount_text) * 100)\nmemo = \"walkin\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    tid = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Txn Get\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Txn Get Cat\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(tid))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(tid), day, acct, cat, amount_text, memo]\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n=== END AC txn-get-existing ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-negative-amount ===\nIntent: A negative stored amount is written with a leading minus and two decimals.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTG2\"\ncat = \"ZZTGC2\"\namount_text = \"-12.34\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount_text) * 100)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    tid = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Txn Get Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Txn Get Cat Two\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-05-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(tid))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[1][4] == amount_text\n=== END AC txn-get-negative-amount ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-absent ===\nIntent: A valid id with no stored transaction exits 4 and writes nothing to stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    absent = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(absent))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-get-absent ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-invalid-id ===\nIntent: An id that is not a positive integer exits 3, never 4, and writes nothing to stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nbad_ids = [\"abc\", \"0\", \"-1\", \"1.5\", \"1e2\", \" \"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for bad in bad_ids:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", bad)\n        print(bad, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-get-invalid-id ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-usage ===\nIntent: A wrong argument count exits 2 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for args in ((\"txn\", \"get\"), (\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\", \"2\")):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        print(args, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-get-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The command never writes to the store.\n- A failing command writes nothing to stdout and exactly one diagnostic line to stderr.\n- Amounts are formatted from integer cents; floating point is never used.\n- An id that is not a positive integer is never reported as absent.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnAmend.md ===\n# FEATURE: TxnAmend\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn amend` command changes only the amount of a stored transaction, subject to the balance rule. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-AmountValidation.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.transactions.txn_row, ledger_app.validation.amount_cents, ledger_app.balances.ensure_non_negative, cli.output.write_table |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` replaces the amount of one stored transaction and writes the\nupdated row. Nothing else about the transaction changes.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Item | Contract |\n|------|----------|\n| Command | `ledger txn amend <id> <amount>`, exactly two arguments |\n| Success output | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the updated row |\n| Exit 0 | The amount was changed |\n| Exit 2 | Wrong argument count; one stderr line showing `ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` |\n| Exit 3 | The id is not a positive integer, the amount is invalid or zero, or the change would leave the account balance below zero |\n| Exit 4 | The id is valid but no such transaction is stored |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Validate the id (positive integer) and the amount (`-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, never zero) first; a\n   bad value exits 3 even when the id is absent.\n2. Look up the transaction with `transactions.get`; none raises NotFound (exit 4).\n3. Compute the account's net change as the new cents minus the old cents and call\n   `ensure_non_negative` on it before any write. Rejection leaves the store unchanged.\n4. Call `transactions.update` with only `txn_id` and `amount`.\n5. Transfer legs may be amended when the balance rule holds; pairing is not enforced.\n6. Call `write_table` with the updated row as the final statement.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list an account's transactions for its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-004` — write: change a transaction amount - supplies: `txn_id`, `amount` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-amend-success ===\nIntent: Amending changes the stored amount, writes the updated row, and leaves date, account, category, and memo unchanged.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTM1\"\ncat = \"ZZTMC1\"\nday = \"2026-05-03\"\nmemo = \"amendme\"\nold_text = \"45.50\"\nnew_text = \"54.50\"\nold_cents = int(Decimal(old_text) * 100)\nnew_cents = int(Decimal(new_text) * 100)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    tid = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend One\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Cat One\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=old_cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid), new_text)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(tid), day, acct, cat, new_text, memo]\n    got = db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid)\n    assert f(got, \"amount\") == new_cents\n    assert f(got, \"date\") == day\n    assert f(got, \"account\") == acct\n    assert f(got, \"category\") == cat\n    assert f(got, \"memo\") == memo\n=== END AC txn-amend-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-absent ===\nIntent: Amending an absent id exits 4 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    absent = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(absent), \"1.00\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=absent) is None\n=== END AC txn-amend-absent ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-invalid-input ===\nIntent: Invalid ids and amounts exit 3 and leave the stored amount unchanged, even for an absent id.\n\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTM2\"\ncat = \"ZZTMC2\"\nstart = 1000\nwith db_session() as db:\n    tid = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Cat Two\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-05-04\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=start, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    for bad_amount in [\"1.234\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"-0.00\", \"abc\", \"\", \"1,00\"]:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid), bad_amount)\n        print(bad_amount, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid), \"amount\") == start\n    for bad_id in [\"abc\", \"0\", \"-1\", \"1.5\"]:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", bad_id, \"1.00\")\n        print(bad_id, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    absent = tid + 1000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(absent), \"1.234\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-amend-invalid-input ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-negative-balance ===\nIntent: An amendment that would leave the account balance below zero exits 3 and changes nothing.\n\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTM3\"\ncat = \"ZZTMC3\"\ncredit = 1000\ndebit = -800\nreduced_text = \"5.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    t1 = base + 1\n    t2 = base + 2\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Three\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Cat Three\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=t1, date=\"2026-05-05\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=credit, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=t2, date=\"2026-05-05\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=debit, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    assert int(Decimal(reduced_text) * 100) + debit < 0\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(t1), reduced_text)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=t1), \"amount\") == credit\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=t2), \"amount\") == debit\n=== END AC txn-amend-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-balance-holds ===\nIntent: An amendment that keeps the balance at or above zero succeeds, including down to exactly zero.\n\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTM4\"\ncat = \"ZZTMC4\"\ncredit = 1000\ndebit = -800\nexact_text = \"8.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    t1 = base + 1\n    t2 = base + 2\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Four\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Cat Four\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=t1, date=\"2026-05-06\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=credit, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=t2, date=\"2026-05-06\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=debit, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    new_cents = int(Decimal(exact_text) * 100)\n    assert new_cents + debit == 0\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(t1), exact_text)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=t1), \"amount\") == new_cents\n=== END AC txn-amend-balance-holds ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-transfer-leg ===\nIntent: A transfer leg can be amended when the balance rule holds, and no pairing is enforced.\n\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTM5\"\nfund = \"ZZTMC5\"\nnew_text = \"2.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    t1 = base + 1\n    t2 = base + 2\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Five\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund, description=\"Amend Fund\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=t1, date=\"2026-05-07\", account=acct, category=fund, amount=5000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=t2, date=\"2026-05-07\", account=acct, category=\"TRANSFER\", amount=-1000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(t2), \"-\" + new_text)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=t2), \"amount\") == -int(Decimal(new_text) * 100)\n=== END AC txn-amend-transfer-leg ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-usage ===\nIntent: A wrong argument count exits 2 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for args in ((\"txn\", \"amend\"), (\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\"), (\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"2.00\", \"x\")):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        print(args, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-amend-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Only the amount changes; date, account, category, and memo are never rewritten.\n- The balance check runs before the update and uses the final balance the change would leave.\n- A rejected amendment changes nothing and writes nothing to stdout.\n- Amounts are integer 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn delete` command removes one stored transaction, subject to the balance rule. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn delete |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.balances.ensure_non_negative, cli.output.write_table |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn delete <id>` removes one stored transaction and writes `deleted` and the id.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Item | Contract |\n|------|----------|\n| Command | `ledger txn delete <id>`, exactly one argument |\n| Success output | Header-less two-row CSV: `deleted`, then the id |\n| Exit 0 | The transaction was removed |\n| Exit 2 | Wrong argument count; one stderr line showing `ledger txn delete <id>` |\n| Exit 3 | The id is not a positive integer, or removal would leave the account balance below zero |\n| Exit 4 | The id is valid but no such transaction is stored |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Validate the id as a positive integer; otherwise Rejected (exit 3).\n2. Look the transaction up with `transactions.get`; none raises NotFound (exit 4).\n3. Call `ensure_non_negative` with the change equal to minus the transaction amount for its\n   account, before any write. Rejection leaves the store unchanged.\n4. Call `transactions.delete`, then `write_table` with the single column `deleted` and the id as\n   the final statement.\n5. Transfer legs may be deleted when the balance rule holds; pairing is not enforced.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list an account's transactions for its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-005` — write: delete a transaction - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-delete-success ===\nIntent: Deleting a stored transaction writes deleted and the id and a read back finds nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTD1\"\ncat = \"ZZTDC1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    tid = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Delete One\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Cat One\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-05-08\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=1000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(tid))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows == [[\"deleted\"], [str(tid)]]\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid) is None\n=== END AC txn-delete-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-absent ===\nIntent: Deleting an absent or already deleted id exits 4 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom description=\"Delete Cat Two\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-05-09\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=500, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    first, out1, err1 = FEATURE-TransferRecord.md ===\n# FEATURE: TransferRecord\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger transfer` command records a paired debit and credit in category TRANSFER as one unit. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md |\n| Provides | ledger transfer, ledger_app.transfers.record_transfer |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.transactions.next_txn_id, ledger_app.transactions.txn_row, ledger_app.balances.ensure_non_negative, cli.output.write_table |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` moves cash between two accounts by storing two\nTRANSFER rows with consecutive ids, so total cash held is unchanged. This story delivers the\nrecording path for valid input; the rejection rules are specified in FEATURE-TransferRules.md.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Item | Contract |\n|------|----------|\n| Command | `ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`, exactly four arguments |\n| Success output | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the outgoing row, then the incoming row |\n| Outgoing row | Account `<from>`, category `TRANSFER`, amount `-amount`, memo `transfer to <to>`, id N |\n| Incoming row | Account `<to>`, category `TRANSFER`, amount `+amount`, memo `transfer from <from>`, id N+1 |\n| Id rule | N is one more than the largest stored `txn_id`, or 1 in an empty table |\n| Library | `record_transfer(db, from_account, to_account, cents, date)` returns the two stored rows and is the single place both legs are written |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Register `transfer` in `cli.commands.transfer` with arity 4 to 4.\n2. Parse the amount with `amount_cents` and the date with the date validator.\n3. Obtain the first id from `next_txn_id`; the second is that id plus one.\n4. Write the outgoing and incoming rows with `transactions.create` as the last step of the\n   command, after every check, so that both legs are stored or neither.\n5. Format both rows with `txn_row` and call `write_table` as the final statement.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions to find the largest id and balances - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — write: store each transfer leg - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-record-legs ===\nIntent: A valid transfer stores and writes two TRANSFER rows with consecutive ids, opposite amounts, the dates supplied, and the specified memos.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nsrc = \"ZZXR1\"\ndst = \"ZZXR2\"\nfund = \"ZZXRC1\"\nday = \"2026-06-01\"\namount_text = \"50.00\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount_text) * 100)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Xfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Xfer Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund, description=\"Xfer Fund\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-05-30\", account=src, category=fund, amount=10000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    max_before = base + 1\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount_text, day)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n    out_row, in_row = rows[1], rows[2]\n    assert int(out_row[0]) == max_before + 1\n    assert int(in_row[0]) == int(out_row[0]) + 1\n    assert out_row[1] == day and in_row[1] == day\n    assert out_row[2] == src and in_row[2] == dst\n    assert out_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\" and in_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert Decimal(out_row[4]) == -Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert Decimal(in_row[4]) == Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert len(out_row[4].split(\".\")[1]) == 2 and len(in_row[4].split(\".\")[1]) == 2\n    assert out_row[5].split() == [\"transfer\", \"to\", dst]\n    assert in_row[5].split() == [\"transfer\", \"from\", src]\n    stored_out = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(out_row[0]))\n    stored_in = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(in_row[0]))\n    assert f(stored_out, \"amount\") == -cents\n    assert f(stored_in, \"amount\") == cents\n    assert f(stored_out, \"account\") == src\n    assert f(stored_in, \"account\") == dst\n=== END AC transfer-record-legs ===\n\n=== AC transfer-record-conserves-cash ===\nIntent: A valid transfer moves exactly the amount between the two balances and leaves the combined balance unchanged.\n\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nsrc = \"ZZXR3\"\ndst = \"ZZXR4\"\nfund = \"ZZXRC2\"\namount_text = \"37.25\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount_text) * 100)\nopening = 10000\n\n\ndef balance(db, account):\n    return sum(f(r, \"amount\") for r in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Xfer Source Two\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Xfer Dest Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund, description=\"Xfer Fund Two\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-05-30\", account=src, category=fund, amount=opening, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    before_total = balance(db, src) + balance(db, dst)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount_text, \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert balance(db, src) == opening - cents\n    assert balance(db, dst) == cents\n    assert balance(db, src) + balance(db, dst) == before_total\n=== END AC transfer-record-conserves-cash ===\n\n=== AC transfer-record-usage ===\nIntent: A wrong argument count exits 2 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for args in (\n        (\"transfer\",),\n        (\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\"),\n        (\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\", \"2026-06-01\", \"extra\"),\n    ):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        print(args, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC transfer-record-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Both legs are written in one step after every check; a transfer never stores a single leg.\n- Both legs use category TRANSFER, with ids N and N+1 in that order.\n- Amounts are integer cents; the incoming leg is exactly the negation of the outgoing leg.\n- Total cash held never changes as a result of a transfer.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TransferRules.md ===\n# FEATURE: TransferRules\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Rejection rules for `ledger transfer`, enforced before either leg is written. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-TransferRecord.md |\n| Provides | ledger_app.transfers.validate_transfer |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.transfers.record_transfer, ledger_app.balances.ensure_non_negative, ledger_app.validation.amount_cents, ledger_app.validation.date |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nA transfer is rejected with exit 3, with neither leg stored and nothing on stdout, when any rule\nbelow fails. All rules are checked before the first write.\n\n## Rules\n\n| Rule | Rejected when |\n|------|---------------|\n| Amount | The amount is invalid, zero, negative, or has more than two decimals |\n| Date | The date is not a real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD` |\n| Distinct accounts | `<from>` and `<to>` are the same code |\n| Known accounts | Either account is not stored |\n| Category | The category `TRANSFER` is not stored |\n| Balance | The source account balance after the transfer would be below zero |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `validate_transfer(db, from_account, to_account, cents, date)` runs the rules in the order\n   above and raises Rejected on the first failure. It writes nothing.\n2. The `transfer` command parses arguments, calls `validate_transfer`, calls\n   `ensure_non_negative` with `{from: -cents, to: +cents}`, and only then calls\n   `record_transfer`.\n3. A transfer that leaves the source at exactly zero is allowed.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-001` — read: confirm an account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-001` — read: confirm the TRANSFER category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list an account's transactions for its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-reject-bad-amount ===\nIntent:    db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Reject One\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Reject Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund, description=\"Reject Fund\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-05-30\", account=src, category=fund, amount=10000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    before = [(f(r, \"txn_id\"), f(r, \"account\"), f(r, \"amount\")) for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    for bad in [\"0\", \"0.00\", \"-0.00\", \"-5.00\", \"1.234\", \"abc\", \"\"]:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, bad, \"2026-06-03\")\n        print(bad, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    after = [(f(r, \"txn_id\"), f(r, \"account\"), f(r, \"amount\")) for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    assert after == before\n=== END AC row by id. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn get |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.transactions.txn_row, cli.output.write_table, cli.registry.register |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn get <id>` reads one stored transaction and writes it as CSV. It is read-only and\nnever changes the store.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Item | Contract |\n|------|----------|\n| Command | `ledger txn get <id>`, exactly one argument |\n| Success output | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the one transaction row; amount has exactly two decimals |\n| Exit 0 | The transaction exists |\n| Exit 2 | Wrong argument count; one stderr line showing `ledger txn get <id>` |\n| Exit 3 | The id is not a positive integer (`abc`, `0`, `-1`, `1.5`, empty); it is never reported as absent |\n| Exit 4 | The id is a valid positive integer but no such transaction is stored |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Register the command in `cli.commands.txn_get` with arity 1 to 1 and the usage line above.\n2. Parse the id: digits only, value at least 1. Anything else raises Rejected (exit 3).\n3. Look the row up with `transactions.get`; none raises NotFound (exit 4).\n4. Format the row with `txn_row` and call `write_table` as the final statement.\n5. A failing command writes nothing to stdout.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-get-existing ===\nIntent: Getting a stored transaction writes the declared header and exactly its row.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nacct = \"ZZTG1\"\ncat = \"ZZTGC1\"\nday = \"2026-05-01\"\namount_text = \"45.50\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount_text) * 100)\nmemo = \"walkin\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    tid = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Txn Get\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Txn Get Cat\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(tid))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(tid), day, acct, cat, amount_text, memo]\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n=== END AC txn-get-existing ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-negative-amount ===\nIntent: A negative stored amount is written with a leading minus and two decimals.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-05-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(tid))\n print(args, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-get-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The command never writes to the assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(tid), day, acct, cat, new_text, memo]\n    got = db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid)\n 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn delete` command removes one stored transaction, subject to the balance rule. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn delete |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.balances.ensure_non_negative, cli.output.write_table |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn delete <id>` removes one stored transaction and writes `deleted` and the id.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Item | Contract |\n|------|----------|\n| Command | `ledger txn delete <id>`, exactly one argument |\n| Success output | Header-less two-row CSV: `deleted`, then the id |\n| Exit 0 | The transaction was removed |\n| Exit 2 | Wrong argument count; one stderr line showing `ledger txn delete <id>` |\n| Exit 3 | The id is not a positive integer, or removal would leave the account balance below zero |\n| Exit 4 | The id is valid but no such transaction is stored |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Validate the id as a positive integer; otherwise Rejected (exit 3).\n2. Look the transaction up with `transactions.get`; none raises NotFound (exit 4).\n3. Call `ensure_non_negative` with the change equal to minus the transaction amount for its\n   account, before any write. Rejection leaves the store unchanged.\n4. Call `transactions.delete`, then `write_table` with the single column `deleted` and the id as\n   the final statement.\n5. Transfer legs may be deleted when the balance rule holds; pairing is not enforced.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list an account's transactions for its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-005` — write: delete a transaction - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Delete One\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Cat One\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-05-08\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=1000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid) is None\n=== END AC txn-delete-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-absent ===\nIntent: Deleting an absent or already deleted id exits 4 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom FEATURE-TransferRecord.md ===\n# FEATURE: TransferRecord\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger transfer` command records a paired debit and credit in category TRANSFER as one unit. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md |\n| Provides | ledger transfer, ledger_app.transfers.record_transfer |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.transactions.next_txn_id, ledger_app.transactions.txn_row, ledger_app.balances.ensure_non_negative, cli.output.write_table |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` moves cash between two accounts by storing two\nTRANSFER rows with consecutive ids, so total cash held is unchanged. This story delivers the\nrecording path for valid input; the rejection rules are specified in FEATURE-TransferRules.md.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Item | Contract |\n|------|----------|\n| Command | `ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`, exactly four arguments |\n| Success output | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the outgoing row, then the incoming row |\n| Outgoing row | Account `<from>`, category `TRANSFER`, amount `-amount`, memo `transfer to <to>`, id N |\n| Incoming row | Account `<to>`, category `TRANSFER`, amount `+amount`, memo `transfer from <from>`, id N+1 |\n| Id rule | N is one more than the largest stored `txn_id`, or 1 in an empty table |\n| Library | `record_transfer(db, from_account, to_account, cents, date)` returns the two stored rows and is the single place both legs are written |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Register `transfer` in `cli.commands.transfer` with arity 4 to 4.\n2. Parse the amount with `amount_cents` and the date with the date validator.\n3. Obtain the first id from `next_txn_id`; the second is that id plus one.\n4. Write the outgoing and incoming rows with `transactions.create` as the last step of the\n   command, after every check, so that both legs are stored or neither.\n5. Format both rows with `txn_row` and call `write_table` as the final statement.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions to find the largest id and balances - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — write: store each transfer leg - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-record-legs ===\nIntent: A valid transfer stores and writes two TRANSFER rows with consecutive ids, opposite amounts, the dates supplied, and the specified memos.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nsrc = \"ZZXR1\"\ndst = \"ZZXR2\"\nfund = \"ZZXRC1\"\nday = \"2026-06-01\"\namount_text = \"50.00\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount_text) * 100)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Xfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Xfer Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund, description=\"Xfer Fund\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-05-30\", account=src, category=fund, amount=10000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    max_before = base + 1\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount_text, day)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n    out_row, in_row = rows[1], rows[2]\n    assert int(out_row[0]) == max_before + 1\n    assert int(in_row[0]) == int(out_row[0]) + 1\n    assert out_row[1] == day and in_row[1] == day\n    assert out_row[2] == src and in_row[2] == dst\n    assert out_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\" and in_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert Decimal(out_row[4]) == -Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert Decimal(in_row[4]) == Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert len(out_row[4].split(\".\")[1]) == 2 and len(in_row[4].split(\".\")[1]) == 2\n    assert out_row[5].split() == [\"transfer\", \"to\", dst]\n    assert in_row[5].split() == [\"transfer\", \"from\", src]\n    stored_out = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(out_row[0]))\n    stored_in = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(in_row[0]))\n    assert f(stored_out, \"amount\") == -cents\n    assert f(stored_in, \"amount\") == cents\n    assert f(stored_out, \"account\") == src\n    assert f(stored_in, \"account\") == dst\n=== END AC transfer-record-legs ===\n\n=== AC transfer-record-conserves-cash ===\nIntent: A valid transfer moves exactly the amount between the two balances and leaves the combined balance unchanged.\n\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\n\nsrc = in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Xfer Source Two\")\n amount_text, \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert balance(db, src) == opening - cents\n    assert balance(db, dst) == cents\n    assert balance(db, src) + balance(db, dst) == before_total\n=== END AC transfer-record-conserves-cash ===\n\n=== AC transfer-record-usage ===\nIntent: A wrong argument count exits 2 with nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for args in (\n        (\"transfer\",),\n        (\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\"),\n out == \"\"\n=== END AC transfer-record-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Both legs are written in one step after every check; a transfer never stores a single leg.\n- Both legs use category TRANSFER, with ids N and N+1 in that order.\n- Amounts are integer cents; the incoming leg is exactly the negation of the outgoing leg.\n- Total cash held never changes as a result of a transfer.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TransferRules.md ===\n# FEATURE: TransferRules\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Rejection rules for `ledger transfer`, enforced before either leg is written. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-TransferRecord.md |\n| Provides | ledger_app.transfers.validate_transfer |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.transfers.record_transfer, ledger_app.balances.ensure_non_negative, ledger_app.validation.amount_cents, ledger_app.validation.date |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nA transfer is rejected with exit 3, with neither leg stored and nothing on stdout, when any rule\nbelow fails. All rules are checked before the first write.\n\n## Rules\n\n| Rule | Rejected when |\n|------|---------------|\n| Amount | The amount is invalid, zero, negative, or has more than two decimals |\n| Date | The date is not a real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD` |\n| Distinct accounts | `<from>` and `<to>` are the same code |\n| Known accounts | Either account is not stored |\n| Category | The category `TRANSFER` is not stored |\n| Balance | The source account balance after the transfer would be below zero |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `validate_transfer(db, from_account, to_account, cents, date)` runs the rules in the order\n   above and raises Rejected on the first failure. It writes nothing.\n2. The `transfer` command parses arguments, calls `validate_transfer`, calls\n   `ensure_non_negative` with `{from: -cents, to: +cents}`, and only then calls\n   `record_transfer`.\n3. A transfer that leaves the source at exactly zero is allowed.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-001` — read: confirm an account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-001` — read: confirm the TRANSFER category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list an account's transactions for its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-reject-bad-amount ===\nIntent:    db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Reject One\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Reject Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund, description=\"Reject Fund\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-05-30\", account=src, category=fund, amount=10000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    before = [(f(r, \"txn_id\"), f(r, \"account\"), f(r, \"amount\")) for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    for bad in [\"0\", \"0.00\", \"-0.00\", \"-5.00\", \"1.234\", \"abc\", \"\"]:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, bad, \"2026-06-03\")\n        print(bad, code, out, err)\n
